summary.text: Selena La Rue Hatch is a Democratic Nevada Assembly member from District 25 who has served since November 2022 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
A teacher in the Washoe County School District, she is vice chair of the Natural Resources Committee.

paragraphs.text: La Rue Hatch was born in Reno, Nevada, where she lives, and graduated from Spanish Springs High School.
She earned a bachelor's degree from Boston University in 2011 and a graduate degree from the University of Nevada, Reno, in 2016.
Her career experience includes working as a teacher in the Washoe County School District.
La Rue Hatch assumed office on November 9, 2022, succeeding Jill Tolles.
For 2025 and 2026 she was assigned to the Education and Judiciary committees and to the Natural Resources Committee as vice chair.
